audit_items.proof_trace: BlobStorageSummary caches epoch and mask at creation but MaxBlobsForEpoch() re-queries current config. When BlobSchedule changes, mask.length (old config) diverges from MaxBlobsForEpoch() return value (new config). Cache key excludes BlobSchedule version, so entries are never invalidated on configuration change.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker triggers P2P sync spanning epoch boundary where BlobSchedule increases max blobs from 6→9. Cached summaries created pre-change have mask[6], but MaxBlobsForEpoch() returns 9 post-change. AllAvailable(9) rejects valid complete blocks, causing sync failures.
